Authorization.description: An `Authorization` header whose value is assembled from a secret (CC-06).

header.description:
The header the credential is written into, `Authorization` when absent.

An open-data feed that authenticates with an API key usually wants it in a header of its own; without this the only way to reach such a feed would be to write the key into `headers` as a value, which is what MF-35 exists to prevent.

scheme.description:
The scheme written before the secret.

`Bearer` when absent on `Authorization`, and nothing at all on any other header: a vendor key header takes the bare key and refuses a scheme in front of it. An explicit scheme always wins.

Build.description: The artifact one build of an `App` published, as the build lane writes it back (AP-13a).

builtAt.description: When the build lane published it.

commit.description: The commit of the source the artifact was built from, 7 to 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

digest.description: The artifact's digest, `sha256:` and 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. The reconciler deploys this and nothing else (AP-72).

sdkVersion.description: The version of the app SDK the artifact was built against.

DataSourceSpec.description: Desired state of a `DataSource`: one connection and its credentials (MF-35).

gtfsRt.description: The GTFS-realtime connection, present when `type` is `gtfs-rt`.

http.description: The HTTP connection, present when `type` is `http`.

input.description: Verbatim input configuration document for runner-provided inputs (PL-50).

mqtt.description: The MQTT connection, present when `type` is `mqtt`.

secrets.description: Secret references for runner-provided inputs (PL-50, MF-35).

tls.description: Transport security for the connection above.

type.description: Which connection block below is the live one.

webSocket.description: The WebSocket connection, present when `type` is `websocket`.

DataSourceType.description: Which kind of feed a DataSource connects to: a typed connection or any runner input (MF-35, PL-50).

oneOf.description: How the trips are running against the timetable.

feed.description: Which of the three GTFS-realtime feeds this URL serves.

HttpConnection.description: An HTTP resource the runner polls (Architecture/08 §6).

authorization.description: The `Authorization` header, built from a secret (CC-06).

headers.description: Static request headers. A header carrying a credential belongs in `authorization`.

timeout.description: Request timeout as a Bento duration, `10s`.

cleanSession.description: Whether the broker forgets the subscription between connections.

qos.description: Quality of service, 0, 1 or 2. Absent leaves Bento's default.

topics.description: Topic filters to subscribe to; at least one.

urls.description: Broker URLs, `tcp://host:1883` or `tls://host:8883`; at least one.

username.description: The user the runner authenticates as; the password is a reference.

MultiLanguageMap.description: Multi-language map keyed by ISO 639-1 two-letter lowercase language codes

ObjectMeta.description: Metadata envelope attached to every platform resource (MF-02).

annotations.description: Key-value annotations for provenance and ownership (MF-08).

description.description: Human-readable description: one string, or the legacy map per locale (UI-50, PF-24).

title.description: Human-readable title: one string, or the legacy map per locale (UI-50, PF-24).

oneOf.description: Resource manifest is in draft state.
Resource is pending review or approval.
Resource is live and active in cluster.

The platform holds something the repository does not declare, or no longer holds what it does (CC-21, UI-25). Configuration cannot reach this phase — every component reads it from the repository (CC-72) — so it is a space whose seed entities the broker answers differently, and the two resolutions of UI-26 are what a person does about it.

SecretRef.description:
Reference to a credential stored in SOPS or OpenBao (PF-36).

`deny_unknown_fields` is a security control: it rejects inline `value:` or `password:` fields at parse time, enforcing that secrets never appear in Git or manifest files.

envVar.description: Optional environment variable name for injection into runners.

Status.description: Server-computed lifecycle and reconciliation status (MF-04). Never stored in Git.

build.description: What the build lane published for an `App`, and the only place its artifact is named (AP-13a). Written back by the build lane in the commit that publishes the artifact; an App without it renders no pod, and no other principal may set it (AP-73).

observedRevision.description: Git commit revision observed during reconciliation.

anyOf.description: The form every new manifest writes.

Text.description: A human label or description (UI-50): one plain string in the author's language. The legacy language map is still read, through release `v0.9`, and resolves to one string.

TlsSettings.description: How the runner trusts the feed's certificate.

caCertRef.description: A private certificate authority the feed's certificate chains to.

insecureSkipVerify.description: Kept so a manifest can state the choice; only `false` is accepted (see [`DataSourceSpec::validate`]).

WebSocketConnection.description: A WebSocket the runner keeps open (Architecture/08 §6).

openMessage.description:
A message sent once the socket opens, usually a subscription request.

A socket that needs a credential authenticates inside this message: Bento's websocket input sends no `Authorization` header, and a field the renderer cannot honour would be a promise the runner breaks.

apiVersion.description: API version: [`API_VERSION`], or a version [`serves`] accepts for this kind.

metadata.description: Metadata identifying and labeling the resource.

status.description: Server-computed status. Stripped during export and serialization.
